prompt:
You are generating a SYNTHETIC document corpus for testing a personal document search tool used by trilingual (Russian/English/Hebrew) households in Israel. Batch id: b01. Theme: rent: apartment lease, deposit receipt, landlord letter about repairs, move-out inspection, utility (electric/water) bills, building committee (ועד בית) notice.

Write 8 markdown documents and save them as:
  corpus/ru/b01-<slug>.md  (3 docs, entirely in Russian)
  corpus/en/b01-<slug>.md  (3 docs, entirely in English)
  corpus/he/b01-<slug>.md  (2 docs, entirely in Hebrew)
Each document: 300-900 words, starts with a `# ` heading, reads like a real scanned/exported document of its kind (letterhead-style header, dates in 2024-2026, sections, amounts in ₪, reference numbers). Realistic but ENTIRELY FICTIONAL: invented people (use names like "Dana Levi-Cohen", "Игорь Шапиро", "נועה ברק"), invented companies, addresses on streets that may exist but with invented house numbers. Hard rules: NO 9-digit numbers anywhere (write IDs as `0XX-XXX-XXX` placeholders or omit), no mobile numbers of the shape 05X-XXXXXXX (use `05X-000-0000`), emails only at example.com, example.org or a name under the reserved .example top-level domain, telephone numbers visibly fictional (03-000-0000, 05X-000-0000) and no short star codes, no real brand names of banks/insurers/HMOs (invent: "Bank Negev", "Клалит" is NOT allowed -> use "Купат холим Ярден"). Content in one language only per file (a few Hebrew/English proper nouns inside Russian text are fine, under 10% of characters).

Also write gold/b01.jsonl with exactly 4 lines, each a JSON object:
  {"q": "<search query a user would type>", "lang": "<ru|en|he>", "expect": ["corpus/<lang>/b01-<slug>.md"], "kind": "<fact|date|amount|howto>"}
Queries must be answerable only by that document (ask about a specific amount, date, clause or name in it). Make at least 1 query cross-lingual: the query language differs from the document language (e.g. Russian query about the Hebrew contract). Query text must be natural, 4-12 words, no quotes from the document verbatim.

And write gold/b01.files: the 8 corpus paths, one per line.

Write the files to disk at these paths.
